title: 2 HITS KO
description:
Starting with a Vi jumping attack, you can land a few hits and then use Vi’s S1 (Vault Breaker) to connect additional hits and launch the opponent.

In the air, follow up with an aerial combo while calling Teemo to place a mushroom.

Tag in and perform Super 2 (Noxious Surprise), then use down S1 (Sharpshooting Scout Up) to make the opponent rise from the combo.

At this point, you’ve dealt 555 points of damage.

Perform a forward jump and grab with Teemo.

When Teemo lands, use his diagonal heavy (Treasure Hunt) to extend the combo, then press down Tag to call Vi during Teemo’s shoryuken animation.

As Vi enters, perform M → H → S1, and finish with Super 2 (Hyper Crater Maker) — mash the S2 button for extra damage.

Total damage: 555 + 407 = 962.
